title: Bayern Munich's Champions League scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most Champions League goals for Bayern Munich since 1992/93.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards

notes.Leroy Sane: Leroy Sane is just outside with 16.

checks: Each player total is the sum of his goals for the club in every season, from UEFA.com season stats and from Transfermarkt season scorer lists; the two agree on every figure shown unless the value gives both. UEFA.com files a mid-season mover's whole season under his later club, so those seasons were split using Transfermarkt game logs. Elber: UEFA.com 22, Transfermarkt 21 (they differ on 1998/99); sixth either way.
